title: BindCraft and ProteinMPNN design miniprotein binders that neutralize PACAP-38
summary: BindCraft designed binders to PACAP-38, giving the 63-residue ICLIST-2 (KD 26.5 nM). ProteinMPNN-guided optimization produced ICLIST-11 with nine substitutions, KD 4.51 nM and a melting temperature 14 C higher. In cell-based assays ICLIST-11 neutralized PACAP-38-induced PAC1R activation with IC50 10.6 nM, outperforming ICLIST-2. The results are in vitro, from the abstract only.
ai_technology: BindCraft de novo binder design and ProteinMPNN sequence optimization
organization: Ajinomoto (Japan); Institute of Integrated Research, Institute of Science Tokyo; Imperial College London

evidence.tested: Binding affinity, thermal stability and cell-based PAC1R neutralization assays.
evidence.unknown: In vivo efficacy or any migraine benefit; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: BindCraft generated the initial binders and ProteinMPNN proposed the affinity-improving substitutions.
